description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Timeless Witness, adding one mana of any color.
When Timeless Witness dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Timeless Witness from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Timeless Witness from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.
